"### Via Docker (recommended)

cd 01-frontend
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 docker build -t frontend ."

For mfe-ws: `Rollup failed to resolve import "shared/style.css"`. This means the `shared` package's `dist/style.css` wasn't built, OR the `shared` package wasn't properly linked. In the mfe-ws Dockerfile, `npm ci --workspace mfe-ws --include-workspace-root=false` is used (NO `--workspace shared`). So the `shared` workspace isn't installed/linked. Then `npm run -w mfe-ws build` tries to import `shared/style.css` which resolves to `shared/dist/style.css` — but shared wasn't built (no `npm run -w shared build` step, and shared isn't in the workspace install).

Compare mfe-fp which SUCCEEDED: it uses `npm ci --workspace mfe-fp --workspace shared --include-workspace-root=false` AND has `RUN npm run -w shared build` before building mfe-fp. So mfe-fp correctly installs AND builds the shared dep.

So the mfe-ws Dockerfile is genuinely missing the `--workspace shared` and the `npm run -w shared build` step that mfe-fp has. This is an **inconsistency in the repo's own Dockerfiles** — mfe-ws is missing the shared-workspace handling that mfe-fp has.
